facts.claim: In the Slack app's untagged thread follow-up flow, the preference must be resolved per reply author (not per thread creator), and an unset preference should be distinguished from an explicit NEVER so the user can still be prompted with a save-default option. The source model comment was updated accordingly.
facts.evidence: products/slack_app/backend/models.py: "# NULL means the user has never picked, so an untagged reply prompts them." and products/slack_app/backend/services/slack_settings.py introduced `saved_untagged_followup_mode` (returns None when unset) separate from `resolve_untagged_followup_mode` (which now defaults unset to ASK, not NEVER, for the prompt path), replacing the old behavior where `resolve_untagged_followup_mode` returned NEVER for an absent row and was keyed off `mapping.mentioning_slack_user_id` (the thread creator) rather than the actual replying user (`event.get("user")` / `slack_user_id` param).
